# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer / Farmhand  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, stout, twenty-year-old youth with a round, expressionless face covered in freckles. He has a very broad, simple smile and lacks grace in his speech and mannerisms.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)_

## Personality

Barney is an extremely shy, phlegmatic, and quiet young man who finds conversation and social interactions difficult. He possesses an intense, awkward shyness around girls, yet harbors a deep pride in accompanying them when given the chance. He enjoys simple outdoor activities like rowing and driving horses, but remains largely passive and unresponsive in social settings.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)_

## Traits

- Extremely shy  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- Phlegmatic and unemotional  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- Lacks conversational skills  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- Proud  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Rowing a boat  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
- Driving a team of horses  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- Provide transportation for community events and picnics  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen resides in Brierley as the son of Gorham Pullen. During the Sunday-school picnic at his father's field, he assists by taking attendees rowing on the Lake of Glassy Waters and rescues Odette Pullen when she nearly falls into the lake. Later in the summer, he uses his family's double-seated buggy to drive his sister Odette, Isolde Pembroke, and Nell Harcourt to the concert at the Pale Sands Hotel. Though proud to ride alongside Nell on the front seat, his shyness prevents him from holding a conversation with her. Upon arriving at the hotel, he flees out of fear of being invited to the performers' dinner, but reliably waits with his team of horses to drive the girls back home after the event.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v1 c16 P39](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0039)_
